instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not use the Blender Python console, Text editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, shell commands, or any helper script/macro to directly generate or edit the deliverable files. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, panels, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Use Bonsai's native IFC structural authoring workflow to create a new IFC4 structural frame with a structural analysis model, then save it as result.ifc. Start from a blank project; no local reference images are provided. The model should have one project, one building storey named Level 00, and no building element proxies. Create four columns named C1, C2, C3, and C4, each with bounding-box spans of 0.30 m by 0.30 m by 3.60 m within about 0.05 m. Their plan center coordinates should be (0.00, 0.00), (6.00, 0.00), (6.00, 4.00), and (0.00, 4.00), within about 0.05 m in X and Y. Add two beams named Front Beam and Rear Beam, each with spans of 6.00 m by 0.30 m by 0.45 m within about 0.05 m. Place Front Beam at Y = 0.00 m and Rear Beam at Y = 4.00 m, with both beam centers at Z = 3.10 m within about 0.05 m. Add one slab named Deck Slab with spans of 6.00 m by 4.00 m by 0.16 m and center Z = 3.63 m, within about 0.05 m. Create one IfcStructuralAnalysisModel named Section Frame with PredefinedType LOADING_3D, assigning exactly the four columns and two beams. Other details may vary.
